AboutIn.description:
What the screen showed when the person tapped "talk about this" (Guy, 13 Nov 2026): an insight, the question its
reading asked, or a follow-up. The text is what the app showed them, from their own data.
AboutIn.title: AboutIn

ClientErrorIn.description: A render error the app caught and survived (13 Nov 2026, the companion character crash). Code facts only.
ClientErrorIn.title: ClientErrorIn

DeviceRatiosOut.description:
Carb ratio by time and correction factor as set on the connected pump (Tandem, 13 Nov 2026). While set, the
typed ones are kept as they were and cannot be edited in Stedio (G-48). Shown only; never used to suggest a dose.
DeviceRatiosOut.title: DeviceRatiosOut

GlucosePatch.description: An edit makes a new revision; the previous values are kept.
GlucosePatch.title: GlucosePatch

GoalsIn.description: "What would you like us to help with?" and "What is hardest for you day to day?" (goals.py lists the values).
GoalsIn.title: GoalsIn

HabitData.description: A habit the person keeps track of (no sensor needed): done or not, with an optional amount in its own unit.
HabitData.title: HabitData

InterpretationOut.description: The model's reading of one insight (interpret.py): what the records show, possibilities, and what is missing.
InterpretationOut.title: InterpretationOut

LabData.description:
A lab or clinic result the person entered (13 Nov 2026), with the date it was taken and where it came from. Stored as
entered; Stedio does not grade it against a range.
LabData.title: LabData

OnboardingAnswers.description: The onboarding draft from the app (version 1). Free text stays as typed; extra keys are rejected.
OnboardingAnswers.title: OnboardingAnswers

PartIn.description: A three-hour part of the day as the card shows it, in ms since 1970.
PartIn.title: PartIn

PumpDayOut.description: One finished day as the pump's 30-day history reports it.
PumpDayOut.title: PumpDayOut

PumpStatusOut.description:
The pump's state at the last poll, as CareLink reported it. Every field is optional: older pumps or a pump out
of reach leave some out.
PumpStatusOut.title: PumpStatusOut

SameAsIn.description: The meal this entry is the same meal as, or null for "a separate meal".
SameAsIn.title: SameAsIn

TandemPumpOut.description: What Tandem Source says about the pump, shown as set on the pump (read-only in Stedio, G-48).
TandemPumpOut.title: TandemPumpOut

UsualOut.description: One type's routine (G-67): middle of the last full days, weekdays and weekend, the busiest part of the day.
UsualOut.title: UsualOut

ViewerOut.description: A share as its owner sees it: who can see their data, or an invite not used yet.
ViewerOut.title: ViewerOut

ViewingOut.description: A share as the viewer sees it: whose data they can see.
ViewingOut.title: ViewingOut

WhyOut.description: "Why am I seeing this?" for one insight: what it rests on and which of the person's goals it speaks to.
WhyOut.title: WhyOut

WordsIn.description: The card's words in the app's language: range labels, "not live · {t}" and "not current".
WordsIn.title: WordsIn

WorkoutsOut.description: Workouts and logged activity of the last weeks: how many, the person's own kinds, when, a middle length.
WorkoutsOut.title: WorkoutsOut

delete.description: Deletes the account and everything in it: rows go with the user (ON DELETE CASCADE), files with its folder.

Deletes another account and everything in it, as the person's own "Delete account" does. Never the admin's own
account or another admin's, and only when the typed email matches the account's.

post.description: Takes an account off the waitlist (Guy, 12 Nov 2026) and emails it. Approving twice changes nothing.
Logs a caught app error for debugging: where, the message and the top frame, without the account or any values.

get.description: Public: it says only which build number is newest and where to install it.

post.description: Sign in or sign up with Apple (iPhone app), linked the same way as Google.

Sign in or sign up with Google. The account is found by its Google id, else by the Google-verified email (an
account made with email and password is linked then), else made new without a password.

get.description: Which ways to make an account are open, so the app and the website show only those.

post.description:
AUTH-04 (Guy, 14 Nov 2026): a 6-digit code by email to set a new password. The answer is the same whether or not an
account has this address, so it never tells who has one; at most one mail a minute per account. Without a mail
sender it says so (503) instead of pretending a mail went out.

schema.title: Response Forgot Password Auth Password Forgot Post

post.description: The emailed code and a new password: the password is set, every other session ends, and this one signs in.
Sends a new code to the signed-in account's email (not more than once a minute).
The companion opens about the item the person was looking at, already knowing it, with a short first line.

get.description: A conversation's messages, oldest first. Without an id: the current one, or none after a quiet gap.

post.description: What the person did with a proposal card: saved (or waiting to sync) through the records API, or dismissed.

get.description: Past conversations for the history sheet. Title and preview are the conversation's own words, not a summary.

delete.description: Forgets the CareLink sign-in. With remove_readings, the readings that came from CareLink are deleted too.

put.description: Signs in to CareLink now. Only a sign-in that worked is kept; a refused one is answered and forgotten.

post.description: Starts a sign-in on CareLink's own page, for when CareLink asks for more than the password (G-29).
Finishes a sign-in made on CareLink's page with the address CareLink returned, and fetches the readings.

delete.description: Forgets the sign-in. With remove_readings, the readings that came from this source are deleted too.

put.description: Signs in now. Only a sign-in that worked is kept; a refused one is answered and forgotten.

get.description: The pump's alerts and messages in a period, for the journal (Guy, 12 Nov 2026), oldest first.

schema.title: Response Device Events Devices Events Get

delete.description: Forgets the sign-in. With remove_readings, the readings that came from this source are deleted too.

put.description: Signs in now. Only a sign-in that worked is kept; a refused one is answered and forgotten.
A token belongs to one account at a time: signing in elsewhere on the same phone moves it.

post.description:
"I changed my set" (Guy, 14 Nov 2026): CareLink reports a set change only in its daily history, hours later, so the
person can say it now. Kept like a pump's set change (one a day), which ends the "set past its days" card.

delete.description: Forgets the sign-in. With remove_readings, the readings that came from this source are deleted too.

put.description: Signs in now. Only a sign-in that worked is kept; a refused one is answered and forgotten.

delete.description: Turning the weather off forgets the kept state.

post.description: Coordinates are rounded and used once for the lookup; only the derived state is kept.

get.description: Follow-ups due in [since, until), plus any still waiting from before `since` (overdue and not closed).

schema.title: Response List Follow Ups Follow Ups Get

put.description:
Pause check-ins (RTN-05, 14 Nov 2026): for an hour, the rest of the day, three days or until turned back on.
Check-ins due meanwhile are withdrawn (a daily one moves to its first day after). Reminders the person set
themselves still arrive.

delete.description: Withdraws this follow-up, or with `series` every open occurrence of a daily one.

post.description: The phone scheduled a local notification for this due time.
"Not today" from the notification (RTN-07): a daily one moves to tomorrow, a one-off is dismissed.

delete.description:
Disconnecting with "Remove imported readings" (SET-05): every reading that came from the phone's health store is
soft deleted. Readings the person entered themselves are not touched.

post.description:
Readings read from Apple Health or Health Connect, in batches. Each sample is stored once (its store id is the
idempotency key), labelled with the store as its source, and never overwrites what the person entered or corrected.
Values outside the entry limits (G-06) are skipped, not changed.

delete.description: Soft delete: gone from the journal and summaries; kept until account deletion.

schema.title: Response Revisions Glucose  Record Id  Revisions Get

get.description:
Steps and active energy as a routine, with the person's best day (G-67). Empty values until there are enough days.
kinds=2 adds exercise minutes, stood hours and the workouts summary (G-69), for app code that knows them.

schema.title: Response List Samples Health Data Samples Get

get.description: `shown=true`: the client lists these insights on screen now, so each listing is kept as learning data.
The first days (RTN-01): which day, entries per day, first impressions of the routine, and what is not known yet.
RTN-02: the first-days summary. Counts and the meal times seen; impressions the person can confirm or reject.

post.description: Keep the extra check-ins a few more days: getting to know the person goes on for EXTEND_DAYS more days, once.

put.description: The person's answer on an impression ("Sounds right" / "Not really"); null clears it.

get.description:
Each hour of the day over the last 14 days (for the lock-screen widget, G-40): how many days had readings then and
how many of those days were above, below or in the person's own range, by that day's middle value in the hour.
With span=3 the blocks are three hours long (00-03, 03-06, ...), for the lock-screen card's part of the day (G-41).
Recent insight updates (new, changed, follow-up, ended, corrected), newest first, whether pushed or not.

schema.title: Response List Updates Insights Updates Get

post.description: What the person did with an insight, kept apart from opening it and from what they said about it.
A personal reading of one current insight. Not for someone viewing a shared account (it would be kept as theirs).
Seen or read on a screen: kept on the server, so the app and the website show the same state.

get.description: The photo of a saved meal, for its Journal card (Guy, 13 Nov 2026). Only the person's own; gone once removed.
Weekly windows up to yesterday (local), the baseline, and whether a change held (see metrics.progress).

schema.title: Response Get Progress Metrics Progress Get

get.description: Data quality: each source's measured rhythm, duplicates and overlaps dropped, gaps and coverage per day.

schema.title: Response Get Quality Metrics Quality Get

get.description: The spread of glucose by time of day over [from, to) (default: the last 14 days), and whether there was enough.

schema.title: Response Get Typical Day Metrics Typical Day Get

put.description: The person says the day's meals are all logged (or not). Only today and earlier.

schema.title: Response Mark Day Nutrition Days  Day  Put

get.description: Changes to the profile answers, newest first (at most 100), optionally for one section ("food", "goals").

schema.title: Response Profile History Profile History Get

get.description:
Wins of the last 14 days, newest first (the daily check runs here too if it is due). `kinds=2`: the client knows
personal bests of steps and active energy (G-67); older app code doesn't get them.

post.description: Seen, or the celebration shown: once, anywhere. A second celebration of the same win is refused (409).

get.description: `kinds=2`: the client knows lab results and habits (13 Nov 2026); older app code gets only the kinds it knows.

delete.description: Soft delete: gone from the journal and summaries; the row and its revisions stay until account deletion.

schema.title: Response Revisions Records  Record Id  Revisions Get

put.description:
Marks this meal entry as the same meal as another (G-47), or, with null, as a separate meal. The entry that points
is shown and counted with the other. Either side can be named: when the other one is a device's entry and this one
is not, the device's entry is the one that points.

get.description: The whole catalog. The check runs here too, so a new unlock shows as soon as the app asks.

post.description: Seen, or the celebration shown (which is also seen). Once, anywhere; unknown or locked ids are ignored.
The viewer enters the code. It works once, within 7 days, and not for one's own data.

delete.description: The owner removes a viewer or cancels an invite; the viewer stops viewing. Takes effect on the next request.

get.description: Whether a voice provider is configured, so the app can show the unavailable state before anyone talks.
A stored companion reply, spoken. A withheld reply has no text and is not spoken.
One fixed sample sentence in a chosen voice and language, with the companion's name. Not a speech service.
